In RAN3 119 meeting, RAN3 agreed to further discuss point#6 (regarding to KI#5) in the Reply LS to SA2 [1]. For point#6 (regarding KI#5): RAN3 needs to conduct further discussions to converge on a solution. RAN3 will inform SA2 for any progress. In this contribution, we’d like to share our understandings on the stage2 procedures in [2], and discuss the stage 3 signalling design for NRPPa/F1AP, and the potential issues based on the understanding of SA2’s conclusion.
